answer: Slashable seat-bonds resist sybils: to act, an identity locks collateral on a narrow ledge above a canyon, and provable misbehavior cuts the rope so the stake is lost. Honest work risks nothing, but each fake must independently fund its own ivory-white bond, and one caught clone forfeits it. A swarm now wagers real capital per head, so mass fakery becomes a losing trade instead of a free registration.
